<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs. Edit the repository definition and its Markdown documentation. -->

Configure a static IPv4 address for eth0 using ifupdown.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

<dl class="parameter-list">

<dt>

`address`

</dt>
<dd>

**Required**

Static IPv4 address for eth0.

</dd>

<dt>

`gateway`

</dt>
<dd>

**Required**

IPv4 default gateway.

</dd>

<dt>

`netmask`

</dt>
<dd>

**Required**

IPv4 subnet mask in dotted-decimal form.

</dd>

</dl>

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value   |
| ------------ | ------- |
| Priority     | `80000` |
| Dependencies | None    |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set unless `before` or
`after` constraints require otherwise. Dependencies include other recipes
without ordering them.

## Behavior

Writes /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth0. The target system must use ifupdown and
name the intended interface eth0.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/eth0-static-ip"]

[parameters."core/eth0-static-ip"]
address = "192.0.2.10"
gateway = "192.0.2.1"
netmask = "255.255.255.0"
```
